title: Cloud platforms
summary: Build a cloud platform around your operating model, with security, cost and governance visible from the start.
overview:
Cloud should give your teams room to move, but provider defaults rarely reflect the way your organisation operates. As accounts, identities, policies and workloads grow, it becomes harder to see how a change will affect the whole environment.

We design and build cloud foundations around your teams, security posture and delivery model. From landing zones and identity integration to Infrastructure as Code and operational automation, we make the platform easier to understand, govern and evolve.
positioning: Give your teams a cloud platform they can operate predictably and change without losing control.
capabilities: AWS, Azure and GCP platform engineering
outcomes: Adopt cloud services with a clear operating model
